connector.name: Self Inspect MCP
connector.registryDescription: Send a thought, get one metathought that makes your agent inspect its own assumptions. Keyless.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.ejentum.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package self-inspect-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ejentum account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
